env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: **[SuperContext](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/super-context)**: a research scout sweeps your memory and files before the model reads your first message. No cold starts.
env_context_strategy.note: Context injected up front plus native tools (coder toolset, browser) let the agent navigate; single-valued dimension, coded closest value `mixed`.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: **[TokenJuice](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/token-compression)**: tool output compressed before it hits the model: same information, up to 80% fewer tokens.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Plus scraper, coder toolset, a real [browser](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/native-tools/browser-and-computer), and [native voice](gitbooks/features/native-tools/voice.md) with in-process Whisper.
observation_format.note: Browser/computer tool implies screenshots; text is the baseline. Not confirmed in code.

tool_schema_source.note: Native tool schema source not visible in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Signal-encrypted agent-to-agent orchestration, x402 USDC bounties and trading.
protocol_standardization.note: MCP from repo topics/integrations; A2A is a proprietary Signal-protocol agent-to-agent channel, not necessarily the published A2A spec.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: **Graphs, not loops**: turns run as checkpointed graphs on [tinyagents](https://github.com/tinyhumansai/tinyagents). They pause for a human, survive a restart, and resume mid-run.
loop_primitives.note: Workflows are trigger-driven graphs; the harness is described as graph-based rather than a single loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **[Goals & Todos](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/goals-and-todos)**: long-term goals, durable per-thread goals, and a shared kanban board per conversation.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a fast reflex agent triages inbound traffic while a deep reasoning core delegates to worker fleets, steered by the subconscious
multi_agent_topology.note: Sub-agents spawn three levels deep, so hierarchical is also reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: **Sub-agent fleets**: specialists spawn three levels deep; stuck agents become root-cause reports.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the agent proposes the automation; you review it on a canvas and save. Durable, trigger-driven, approval-gated runs
human_in_loop.note: Approval gate also listed under privacy & security; plan review on canvas is the default for workflows.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: long-term goals, durable per-thread goals, and a shared kanban board per conversation

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: your data compressed into scored Markdown trees in SQLite on your machine, mirrored as an [Obsidian vault](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2039805659525644595) you can open and edit. No vector-soup black box.
long_term_memory.note: 90,000+ Skills gives skill_library; SQLite memory store coded episodic_db.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: They pause for a human, survive a restart, and resume mid-run.

rollback.note: Value list has no `checkpoint`; closest is `snapshot` for state restore, but no file/repo rollback described. Coded closest available concept; see ambiguity.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: [Model routing](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/model-routing) picks the right LLM per workload on one subscription.
cost_controls.note: TokenJuice compression reduces tokens; per-call cost accounting reported. token_budget inferred from cost accounting, low certainty.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: on-device encrypted data, approval gate, OS-keyring secrets, and opt-in sandboxing
execution_isolation.note: Desktop Tauri app running locally; sandboxing is opt-in, so default is unsandboxed local execution. Closest value chosen between `none` and `subprocess`.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: install to working agent in a few clicks, with no config files and no terminal
filesystem_access.note: Local-first desktop app with coder toolset; no path scoping described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: flip one switch and no inference leaves your machine, enforced in the Rust core
network_policy.note: Privacy Mode restricts inference egress but is opt-in; default is open network.

permission_model.evidence_quote: on-device encrypted data, approval gate, OS-keyring secrets, and opt-in sandboxing
permission_model.note: Approval gate described as a security feature; default scope unclear.

tracing.evidence_quote: Replayable run journals + per-call cost accounting

replayability.evidence_quote: every run replays with real per-call costs

guardrails.evidence_quote: Saved workflows are durable and trigger-driven. They fire on schedules, webhooks, or channel events, survive restarts, and gate side effects behind approvals.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Plus scraper, coder toolset, a real [browser](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/native-tools/browser-and-computer), and [native voice](gitbooks/features/native-tools/voice.md) with in-process Whisper.
target_domain.note: `other` = personal assistant / second brain (memory, meetings, messaging channels).

open_source.evidence_quote: OpenHuman is an open source agent harness with local-first memory, agent orchestration, and workflows
open_source.note: README comparison table lists licence as GNU; LICENSE file present but not quoted in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: point any workload at [your own provider key or a fully local Ollama model](https://tinyhumans.gitbook.io/openhuman/features/model-routing/local-and-byok-models), and mix the three however you like
